question: Which catalyst in Table 5 is reported with a higher biodiesel yield than the present GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4, and at what temperature was it run?
rendered: The CaO/HAP/MnFe@K catalyst has a reported biodiesel yield of 99.10%. However, it was run at a temperature of 67.72 °C, which is lower than the temperature of the present GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 catalyst (65 °C).
